# `prefer-memset`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a full-slice pointer-capture loop that only assigns one invariant value
to each element.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`@memset` names the fill operation and gives the compiler its strongest
optimization shape.

## When it fires

The body must be a single `element.* = value` statement and the value must not
refer to the capture. Exact matches receive a fix-all rewrite.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn clear(items: []u8) void {
    for (items) |*item| {
        item.* = 0;
    }
}
```
